ZinX8664Backend.Encoder: Direct machine-code byte emission. No external assembler is required.
ZinX8664Backend.OptionalFeatures: sse3 ssse3 sse4_1 sse4_2 avx avx2 bmi1 bmi2 popcnt
ZinX8664Backend.VectorLowering: Use enabled native feature set; otherwise scalarize when legal.
ZinX8664Backend.Relocations: Backend emits symbolic relocations consumed by integrated object writer/linker.
ZinX8664Backend.RegisterAllocator: Bootstrap may use linear scan. Spill slots are stack allocated and aligned to value requirements.
